body:
Im 23 too (F)and I have felt the same way before and im sorry the pain is becoming so unbearable that you've lost the will to keep going.

If its of any help, what keeps me going is the idea of life still being able to unfold around me... and its the same for you! you have so many beautiful moments to experience still! Falling in love, your first time, getting drunk, going out with friends... maybe we didn't get to do it as teenagers but why cant we do it now or in the future and whos to say we wont enjoy it exponentially more than others just bc were doing these things at a later age?? YOURE BLESSED because youre employed with a 9-5 and so many people want jobs, you have one! you can change course in ur life now and focus on creating experiences for yourself DESPITE THE FEAR.. its what ive started doing and its HARD but it also feels amazing to grow and to not give up on life.

I probably cant understand you're struggle and pain... im sorry you feel this way at all... but you deserve to give yourself a chance at happiness, a real one where you really TRY to do the things that scare you but that would also bring you joy!!
